description: One case per toggle: the estate with agentsEnabledInPublicDemoUi on and nothing else. The known answer is F-AGENTS-PUBLIC, the Finding of Check AGENTS-PUBLIC, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: agentsEnabledInPublicDemoUi, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 agentsEnabledInPublicDemoUi=true
setup.note: the as-found script does not offer this toggle yet (#406 to #408); until it does, the known answer is checked only against the local snapshot

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: Agents are on in a public Demo UI. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
